description: StateView is a custom UI component used in Android applications to manage and display different UI states such as loading, empty, and content within a single reusable widget.

classes.name: StateView
classes.description: A custom Android view class that displays different UI states (loading, empty, content) and provides methods to switch between them.

methods.name: displayLoading
methods.description: Displays a progress bar indicating loading state, hides other content.

methods.name: displayEmpty
methods.description: Displays an empty message, hides progress and content.

methods.name: displayContent
methods.description: Displays the main content container, hides progress and empty message.

methods.name: contentContainer
methods.description: Returns the FrameLayout that acts as a container for content, allowing external code to add views.
